title: Top 10 High Paying Refer and Earn Apps In India 2026
summary: Top 10 high paying refer and earn apps in India 2026: which pay Rs 500-2,000 per referral, how each reward works, and steps to start free without KYC.
body_markdown:
Most refer and earn apps pay very little. A few pay big. The reason is simple: **high paying refer and earn apps** give big rewards when your friend does something valuable, like getting a credit card approved or opening an account. Apps that only need an install pay small amounts. So use your referrals where one friend can earn you Rs 500-2,000, not Rs 50.


This guide ranks the top 10 high paying refer and earn apps in India for 2026 (for the broader landscape, see our[legit refer and earn apps](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-earn-2026-legit-apps/) roundup), with what each app really pays, when you get the reward, and simple steps to start. All ten are free to join, and money comes to your bank, UPI, or wallet. One honest note: offers keep changing, so always check the live offer inside the app before you share.


## 1. GroMo - The Highest Paying Referral App in India


**Reward range: Rs 500-2,000+ per approved referral | Payout: bank account**


GroMo is number 1 because its rewards come from banks as commissions. These are much bigger than normal app bonuses. You refer real financial products: credit cards (Rs 1,000-2,000+ per approval), savings accounts, personal loans, and demat accounts from[India's leading banks and NBFCs](https://gromo.in/blog/is-gromo-real-or-fake/) . One approved credit card pays more than a full month of UPI referral bonuses. And there is no limit on how many people you can refer.


One big benefit: on most investment apps, you must first open your own demat account before you can refer one. On GroMo, a simple free registration lets you[refer without product KYC of your own](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-and-earn-apps-without-kyc/) : demat accounts, cards, and loans without holding those products yourself, and the same customer can come back to you for their next product.


**How to refer on GroMo:**


1. Download the GroMo app and register free.
2. Complete the quick verification and free training.
3. Pick a product and share its application link on WhatsApp.
4. Track the application in the app; the commission credits after approval.


## 2. GiveRefer - One Place for Many Referral Deals


**Reward range: varies by live deal | Payout: UPI/bank**


GiveRefer collects refer and earn offers from many apps in one place. You pick the best paying live deals instead of searching app by app. Your earning depends on the deals listed that month, so treat it as an extra app, not your main earner.


**How to refer on GiveRefer:**


1. Sign up free and browse the live referral deals.
2. Pick the deals that fit your friends genuinely.
3. Share your code or link for that deal.
4. Earn when the referral completes the qualifying action.


## 3. CashKaro - Lifetime 10% Referral Override


**Reward: 10% of friends' cashback earnings for life, plus rotating join bonuses | Payout: bank, UPI, gift cards**


CashKaro's referral reward keeps growing: refer a friend once, then earn 10% of their cashback forever. A few friends who shop online regularly can become steady monthly income for you. Sign-up bonus offers also add Rs 100-500 per friend at times.


**How to refer on CashKaro:**


1. Open the app and go to the Refer and Earn tab.
2. Share your referral link.
3. Your friend joins free and shops via CashKaro.
4. Your 10% override accrues automatically on their cashback.


## 4. EarnKaro - Referral Income as a Deal-Sharing Business


**Reward: affiliate commission on every sale plus 10% of invitees' earnings | Payout: bank transfer**


EarnKaro pays you commission when anyone buys through your shared links. On top of that, you get 10% of whatever your invited friends earn. People who share deals daily make Rs 3,000-15,000 a month. After GroMo, this works most like a real small business.


**How to refer on EarnKaro:**


1. Register free on the app.
2. Share your invite link with people who share deals.
3. Convert product links into profit links and post them daily.
4. Commissions confirm after return windows and pay to your bank.


## 5. Paytm Refer and Earn


**Reward range: Rs 50-150 per referral, campaign-based | Payout: wallet/UPI cashback**


Paytm's referral program is one of the oldest. You get paid when your friend joins and makes their first payment. Offers change often and each campaign has a limit on referrals.


**How to refer on Paytm:**


1. Open Paytm and tap your profile icon.
2. Select Refer and Win.
3. Share your link on WhatsApp.
4. The reward credits after your friend's first qualifying transaction.


## 6. Google Pay (GPay) Refer and Earn


**Reward range: Rs 50-201 per referral, campaign-based | Payout: directly to bank**


GPay usually runs the biggest UPI referral offers, like the famous Rs 201 ones. The money goes straight to your bank account after your friend's first payment.


**How to refer on Google Pay:**


1. Open GPay and tap your profile.
2. Select Invite friends, get rewards.
3. Share your code or link.
4. The reward credits after your friend's first payment.


## 7. PhonePe Refer and Earn


**Reward range: Rs 50-200 per referral, campaign-based | Payout: wallet/bank cashback**


PhonePe pays when your invited friend joins with your link and makes their first UPI transfer. Rewards sometimes come as scratch cards, so the amount varies.


**How to refer on PhonePe:**


1. Open PhonePe and go to your profile.
2. Tap Refer and Get.
3. Share the invite link with a friend new to PhonePe.
4. The reward credits after their first money transfer.


## 8. Upstox Refer and Earn


**Reward range: commonly Rs 100-500+ per funded account, campaign-based | Payout: bank/rewards**


Share market apps pay well because a trading customer is worth a lot to them. Upstox rewards you when your friend opens and activates a demat account. The catch: you usually need your own Upstox account first. GroMo's demat referrals do not need that.


**How to refer on Upstox:**


1. Open your Upstox account and find the refer section.
2. Share your referral link.
3. Your friend completes demat KYC and activates the account.
4. The reward credits per the live campaign terms.


## 9. CRED Refer and Earn


**Reward range: campaign-based cash and rewards | Payout: bank/rewards**


CRED pays you for inviting friends who have a good credit score, because only they can join. Rewards change with each campaign, and usually both of you get something. Share it only with friends who already use credit cards and pay bills on time.


**How to refer on CRED:**


1. Open CRED and find the refer option in your profile.
2. Share your invite with friends who have good credit scores.
3. They join by verifying their score and paying a bill.
4. Rewards credit per the running campaign.


## 10. Navi Refer and Earn


**Reward range: campaign-based, commonly Rs 50-200 per referral | Payout: bank/UPI**


Navi runs referral offers on its UPI and other products. You get paid when your friend makes their first UPI payment or completes the required action. The amount depends on the live offer.


**How to refer on Navi:**


1. Open the Navi app and locate Refer and Earn.
2. Share your referral link.
3. Your friend completes the qualifying first action.
4. The reward credits per the campaign terms.


## What Separates High Paying Referrals from Low Paying Ones


- **Value of the action:** when your friend gets a credit card or opens a demat account, the bank earns a lot, so it pays you a lot. An app install earns them very little, so you get very little.
- **Limits:** UPI offers have monthly limits per user. Platforms like GroMo have no such limits because banks always want more customers.
- **Growing income:** lifetime rewards (CashKaro, EarnKaro) and repeat customers (GroMo) beat one-time bonuses over any 6 months.
- **The smart mix:** UPI apps for quick small wins, CashKaro or EarnKaro for growing income, and GroMo as your main earner for cards, loans, demat, and savings referrals.


## FAQ: High Paying Refer and Earn Apps


**Which UPI app gives more referral money?**


Google Pay has historically paid the most among UPI apps, with campaigns up to Rs 201 per referral credited straight to your bank. PhonePe typically ranges Rs 50-200 and Paytm Rs 50-150, while Navi campaigns sit around Rs 50-200. UPI offers keep changing and have limits, so the answer changes every month. Open each app's invite screen and compare the live offers before sharing.


**Which app has the highest paying credit card refer and earn?**


GroMo leads[credit card refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-refer-and-earn/) with Rs 1,000-2,000+ per approved card, because banks pay full commissions for new card customers. Banks also run their own card referral offers, but those cover only that one bank's cards. A multi-bank platform lets you pick the card your friend is most likely to get approved for, so you earn more.


**Which app has the highest paying demat refer and earn?**


Brokers like Upstox pay well per funded account, but require you to hold your own KYC-verified demat account first. GroMo's[demat refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/demat-account-refer-and-earn/) removes that problem: you can refer demat accounts without opening one yourself, and earn a commission on every approved account. That makes it the easiest high-paying option.


**Which app has the highest paying savings account refer and earn?**


Savings account referrals pay best on platforms like GroMo, not on reward apps. Helping someone open a zero-balance savings account pays a commission set by the bank, usually much more than the Rs 50-200 UPI bonuses. The same customer can later take a card, loan, or demat account through you.


**Which app has the highest paying personal loan refer and earn?**


Loan referrals pay among the highest amounts because lenders pay a share of the loan amount. Through[personal loan refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/personal-loan-refer-and-earn/) on GroMo, you earn when a loan gets approved and paid out, across 30+ lending partners. One genuine loan referral can pay more than dozens of app-install bonuses.


**Are high paying refer and earn apps free and without KYC?**


All ten in this guide are free to join, and none require product KYC just to refer (see our full guide to[refer and earn apps without KYC](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-and-earn-apps-without-kyc/) ). Your friend completes the normal verification for their new account. That is what makes the bigger rewards real. Any app demanding a joining fee or deposit to unlock referral income is a scam.


## Disclaimer


Nothing here is a guarantee of income. Referral rewards, offers, and program terms change frequently and vary by user, campaign, and season; always check the current refer and earn offer inside each app before sharing, as the app's live terms are the only ones that apply. GroMo commissions are set by partner banks and financial institutions, vary by product and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications; check the live commission in the GroMo app before relying on any figure. GroMo is available only to users aged 18 and above.


Everything above is general information, not financial advice. Third-party app names are trademarks of their respective owners. Never pay a fee or share an OTP to earn from any referral program.
